span.span: Executor: verbatim code from the deployed runner

The functions below are copied from the harness that ran the stream and show everything a verifier program can touch. Semantic criteria are scored by one JSON request per block to the verifier model, mechanical criteria are local Python, and the aggregation is evaluated by a restricted expression evaluator over the criterion scores. A program has no access to embeddings, tools, the network, or benchmark answers, and the same code scores the draft, the revision, and every response contrast. The listing keeps the original identifiers, with C.SCORER the verifier model, C.ACTOR the actor, and EPS the acceptance margin.
